sections.context: cursa de rățuște is a charity rubber duck race in iași. people adopt a numbered rubber duck, the ducks race [where / how], and every duck sold funds a children's neuropsychiatry ward.
sections.problem: a few weeks before race day, sales stalled. the people who buy for a good cause had already bought, and [X] ducks were still waiting for a home. another 'please support us' post wasn't going to fix that.
sections.idea: stop asking for donations. give people a reason to buy today, and talk to every audience in its own language.

whatWeDid.title: a week of rapid-fire deals
whatWeDid.text: daily giveaways and sponsor 1+1 offers with deadlines.

whatWeDid.title: ducks with a voice
whatWeDid.text: gen z / millennial message variants, propaganda-style humor, guerrilla marketing.

whatWeDid.title: rubber duck debugging, for charity
whatWeDid.text: a reddit r/programare post targeting programmers; corporate IT workers became the biggest buyers.

whatWeDid.title: a website that listens
whatWeDid.text: built the event site to track where sales came from, and reallocated budget/messaging to what converted.
